performance_claims: NONE. No backtest executed. No ranking implied.

data_profiles.P1: Binance spot public archive (data.binance.vision), USDT quote, 1H klines
data_profiles.P2: Coinbase Exchange public REST, USD quote (incomplete 2021 coverage for several alts)

conventions.x[k]: value k completed bars before the current completed bar; x[0] current
conventions.target_fill: bar high strictly above target; fill target*(1-s)
conventions.cooldown: entry signal evaluable only from close of bar k+1 after exit fill in bar k

indicators.SMA_n: mean of last n values incl. current
indicators.ATR_n: Wilder; seed = mean of first n TR
indicators.RSI_n: Wilder; seed = simple mean of first n changes; avg_loss=0 -> 100; both 0 -> 50
indicators.median: mean of two middle values for even n
indicators.HC: highest close since entry incl. entry-bar close once complete

risk.allocation_order: exits and stops first; entries sorted by strategy_id then symbol; E frozen before sequential allocation

liquidity.L1: median of last 30 completed UTC daily quote volumes >= 20000000
liquidity.L2: sum of last 24 completed 1H quote volumes >= 10000000

strategies.hypothesis: Risk-adjusted multi-week returns in large crypto assets are positively autocorrelated.
falsification: MOM-F9: placebo entries at M<=0 with identical exits must not have ratio below real rule's

strategies.hypothesis: Forced-selling overshoots inside a long-term uptrend partially reverse within days.

long.trail: armed when a completed bar closes >= O1 + 1.0*ATR14[entry]; then stop[t+1] = max(stop[t], O1, HC[t] - 1.5*ATR14[t])

regime_hypothesis.suited: uptrend dips, wide range, ample liquidity

failure_mechanisms: cost drag on small SMA20 gaps
falsification: REV-F9: same rule without C>SMA300 must not match or beat filtered rule
REV-F10: sum of 5 worst losses > total gross profit => reject

strategies.hypothesis: Volume-confirmed range-expansion breakouts mark informed or forced flow that continues for hours.

indicators.ctx4h: most recent 4H bar with close time <= 1H close time: C4 > SMA_50(C4)

signal_exit: bars 1..6 after entry (bar 1 = entry bar): C[0] < DH48_at_signal

regime_hypothesis.suited: quiet-to-active vol transition in liquid sessions
regime_hypothesis.unsuited: thin/weekend liquidity, fully retraced news spikes

failure_mechanisms: cost-feasibility gate may skip many signals (unknown)
falsification: VEX-F9: same rule without volume condition must not match or beat volume-confirmed rule

falsification_common.F1: baseline aggregate net P&L / aggregate reserved risk <= 0 in validation => reject
falsification_common.F2: ratio <= 0 under either cost stress => cost-fragile
falsification_common.F3: one-sided 99.17% block-bootstrap lower bound of ratio <= 0 => cannot pass
falsification_common.F4: ratio below 95th percentile of 1000 random-entry nulls (same exits/count/symbols) => no entry edge
falsification_common.F5: half or more of single-parameter neighbours have ratio <= 0 => fragile
falsification_common.F6: dropping best ceil(5%) trades by R makes ratio <= 0 => outlier-dependent
falsification_common.F7: fewer than 100 closed pooled trades => INCONCLUSIVE
falsification_common.F8: positive ratio in fewer than 2 of 3 equal subperiods of train+validation => unstable
falsification_common.authority: dispositions only from research/validation/adjudicate.py; UNKNOWN mandatory gate never qualifies

testing.registration_required: register 3 trials in ledger and preregister before any test-split access (not yet done)
